Прокси работает только для Telegram: ост: The proxy works for Telegram only: it does not see the rest of the traffic. The link does not grant access to the account but does let others use the proxy — do not publish it.
Сайты (домены), по одному на строку. При: Sites (domains), one per line. On connection the name is resolved to IP and added to the rules together with the IP list, and re-resolved no more than once every 10 minutes. The wildcard *.example.com covers the domain itself and known subdomains. After editing the list the old routes are replaced.
Секрет должен быть hex-строкой (ee… или: The secret must be a hex string (ee… or dd…) or base64 of the same bytes
